answer_1.quote: We evaluate CoFE on three summarization datasets: XSum, GigaWord, and WikiHow.

answer_2.quote: We use similarity to the reference as a proxy measure, and report ROUGE and BertScore. ( ) Faithfulness. For automatic evaluation, we use QuestEval... we also report coverage and density...

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation on 100 randomly selected examples from each dataset. Given a document with the generated summaries from all systems (including the references), we ask annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk to evaluate whether each summary is supported by the document.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate whether each summary is supported by the document
